notes.title: Challenge Other Couriers in Knockout Mode
notes.notes:
Hello Bicycle Courier!


Do you want to test your bicycle couriering skills against others? See who can scour the streets of New Island the fastest and deliver parcels quickly (and "safely” is also desirable, but not a necessity.) 


Then good news. You can! 


Open your phone and select the Strift app to see other players time trials across the eight different zones. Challenge yourself to climb the leaderboards and beat your friends. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238128/5b0301ac85fd5cee06443a1cdd5bd73220001d31.png[/img]

Speaking of friends, why not head to The Hub and join them for a ‘friendly’ game of Knockout? Compete with up to five other couriers – across all platforms – to deliver packages the fastest around your zone of choice. 


Each round, the slowest rider will face their customer’s wrath and be eliminated, while everyone else gets more hard-earned cash*. Sweet, right? 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238128/bfb6914eacb34d2c6b9e1a932b699f512adfe157.gif[/img]

Speaking of cash, you need a way to spend it. Inside the darkened corridors of The Hub, you can find the handy workshop ‘Bikey Boys’ to customise your bike to ride in style. 

From changing colours to fitting new parts, you can do it all. Unlock new driveshafts, wheels, handles, and more as you progress through your global delivery domination. Purchase them at Bikey Boys, or through their nifty phone app.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238128/58fb6d105018a52ac51f9ac7e8638663d48f9d3a.gif[/img]

Change a spoke before you go broke!


* after taxes, deductions, and running costs.

notes.title: Performance update
notes.notes:
Hi folks, thanks for your patience, it's fair to say that our Steam launch didn't exactly go off without a hitch! But, I'm happy to say this new patch addresses many of the issues folks encountered on launch day. We intend to support Parcel Corps for a long time to come so keep checking back, more improvements and extra content are in the works. Keep an eye on the discussion forum and thank you again for your patience. I hope you enjoy our game.
[i]Will Barr, Parcel Corps Game Director[/i]

[b]Patch Notes - v98.9[/b]

Fixes:
[list]
[*] “Contacts” character selection app not swapping player character
[*] Location icons not selectable in Delivery Rush
[*] Missions not removing custom drop-offs when completed
[*] Items awarded by businesses unlock in Bike Shop app correctly
[*] Grind rails disappearing in Parklands level
[*] Control not returned to player after “Resistance” mission briefing cutscene
[*] PlayStation type controller sprites added
[/list]

Improvements:
[list]
[*] Various cutscene animations updated
[*] Performance improvements
[*] In-game progression now more robust
[*] Additional graphics options:
[list]
[*] Full Screen - a toggle cycle between Fullscreen and Windowed modes
[*] MSAA - can set anti-aliasing to values 2x, 4x, 8x, OFF
[*] Texture Quality - can set the texture levels in-game to values Low, Medium, High
[*] Motion Blur - a toggle to cycle ON or OFF
(This is in addition to the Resolution and VSync settings already present.)
[/list]

notes.title: Parcel Corps is like Mirror's Edge on a bike, and it's out right now
notes.notes:
There's a mini-game in this year's Like a Dragon: Infinite Wealth in which Ichiban Kasuga, one of the game's dual protagonists, gets a taste of the gig economy life by delivering food around Hawaii on a bicycle. Play around with this side activity for a little bit and you may start to miss the frenetic structure of the similarly designed Crazy Taxi or the fast-paced urban exploration of Jet Set Radio. Fortunately, anyone wishing for more in this vein is in luck. A new game called Parcel Corps has just launched on Steam, providing another venue for acrobatic bike delivery.

Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: Ding dong! Parcel Corps has arrived.
notes.notes:
[b]Hello bicycle couriers! [/b]

 

Ding dong! Did someone here order a moderately amusing, satirical, bicycle courier action game? Because it's on your doorstep right now! 

 

That’s right, [i]Parcel Corps[/i] is here! It’s all about high speed, high octane, low wage action, as you skid, bunny hop, and wallride your way through the streets of New Island. Choose from one of three bicycle courier corporations to swear your allegiance to, before racing against the clock to deliver parcels on behalf of an eclectic cast of business owners. 

 

More of a group cyclist? Keen to mix it in the peloton? Jump online and compete against other couriers in furious knockout action to determine who rules the gig economy! Or post your fastest times in tricky trials via the Strift app and dominate the leaderboards. Who says gruelling physical labour can't be fun-tastic? Did we mention it’s also crossplay? Pedal for both your courier and platform of choice! 

 

For a limited time only, [i]Parcel Corps[/i] has a 10% launch discount. But hurry, because when it’s over, it’s over (please note that we will not accept expired discount coupons.) 

 

A handy [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2015960/view/4672012242385746014]FAQ leaflet[/url] is attached to your parcel. You can see our launch trailer below.

notes.title: Parcel Corps FAQs, Hot off the Press!
notes.notes:
If you have further questions, please post them in Steam Discussions and we’ll do our best to answer.  

  

[b]Q) What is Parcel Corps? [/b]

[b]A)[/b] In this satirical action-adventure game, you will take the form of a freelance bicycle courier, delivering packages and running errands for businesses of all kinds around New Island. Play alone or with friends as you perfect your routes and pedal for your life! 

Ditch the 9-5 and embrace the high-octane life of a freelance bicycle messenger! Forget the job security, stable salary, and basic workplace rights less cool jobs offer while you ride along walls, grind rails, and startle pigeons on your way to corporation-toppling domination. 


[b]How long is Parcel Corps?[/b]
 
[b]A)[/b] Parcel Corps has eight bustling sandbox levels bursting with mission-giving businesses across New Island. The main story will take most players around 15 hours to complete, but there is much, much more to discover beyond the campaign mode, including side-missions, hidden secrets to root out, collectibles, and the quest to level up all business contracts. Parcel Corps also boasts leaderboard challenges across all levels, as well as a cross-platform multiplayer mode supporting six players.
 

[b]Q) What platforms is Parcel Corps on?  [/b]

[b]A)[/b] Parcel Corps is on PC, Xbox Series S|X, and PlayStation 5.

 

[b]Q) How much is Parcel Corps? [/b]

[b]A)[/b] Parcel Corps costs $34.99/£29.99/€34.99.
  

[b]Q) What are the Minimum PC specs?  [/b]

[b]A) [/b]Please see the infographic below for minimum specifications. 

 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238128/9ee6fec874d3f7e23b3ee17af38bb5b31d61be12.png[/img]
 


[b]Q) Can I use a controller?  [/b]

[b]A)[/b] Yes! While a keyboard can be used, we highly recommend using a controller for Parcel Corps. Controls can be customized from the in-game Options menu.  

The controller mapping has been designed to mirror the handlebars of a real bike, which is why the front and back brakes are assigned onto the different triggers. So now you know! 

 

[b]Q) What are the controls? [/b]

[b]A)[/b] Here are the default controls. 

 

[b]Controller (Xbox/PlayStation): [/b]

 

Directional Travel – Left stick 

Pedal – A / Cross 

Slide – B / Circle 

Jump/Tricks - X / Square 

Open Phone – Y / Triangle 

Control Phone – Right stick, click in to confirm, B / Circle to go back 

Front Brake - LT 

Skid/Rear Brake - RT 

Rail Grind – LB 

Tuck – RB 

Ring Bell – Click Right Stick  

Photo Mode - Share Button / Press Touchpad.
 

[b]Keyboard and Mouse: [/b]

 

Directional Travel – WASD 

Pedal – Shift 

Slide – Control 

Jump/Tricks - Space Bar 

Open Phone – TAB 

Control Phone – Arrow Keys, Enter button to confirm, backspace to go back 

Front Brake - [ 

Skid/Rear Brake - ] 

Rail Grind – E 

Tuck – Alt 

Ring Bell – Q 

 

[b]Q) How do I report bugs?  [/b]

[b]A)[/b]  Please inform us of any bugs on our Steam Forums or Discord. We’re here to help! Sometimes it may just be a case of a graphics driver needing to be updated, and other times we may need to investigate further! Alternatively, you can fill our [url= https://wearesecretmode.com/]"Provide feedback"[/url] form on the bottom right of our website.

  

[b]Q) Can I play on Steam Deck? [/b]

[b]A)[/b] Parcel Corps is playable on Steam Deck! 

   

[b]Q) How do I play Multiplayer?   [/b]

[b]A)[/b] Once you have successfully recruited three businesses to your app, you will unlock the ability to race against other players! 

Go to one of the Internet Cafe HUBs to join up with up to five friends in the “Knock out” mode. Compete to drop off your parcels, with the slowest riders’ contracts terminated after every delivery. 

After meeting a certain character in the Old Town, you can also compete against other couriers in time trials via the “Strift” app. Open this app at any time to compare yourself to other players. Post your best times to the leaderboards across routes throughout New Island and become the envy of your peers! 

[b]Q) How do I customise my bike?[/b]
[b]A)[/b] When you unlock the HUB (after recruiting the first three businesses), you can go inside and customise your bike. Further through the game, you will unlock the ability to purchase more bike customisation (including a cat basket!) with the money you make from your deliveries.

 

[b]Q) Any tips for playing Parcel Corps? [/b]

[b]A)[/b] When moving, you can maintain speed by pushing forward on the Left Stick, which gives you better precision when making turns. Mashing the Pedal button gets you to your max speed, but you don't need to keep mashing to stay there  

 

Your GPS is a good starting place for finding your way around, but make sure to explore and find faster routes. Look for paths above street level to save time and avoid the police and use grind rails as often as you can!  

 

For jobs with multiple deliveries, you can use the D-pad to cycle through your destinations to find the closest one and plan a new route  

 

Chaining together parkour moves builds a special meter, represented as a lightning bolt in the bottom centre of the screen. Once it's filled, hold the Tuck button and then mash the Pedal button (e.g. RB + A on Xbox controllers) to boost your max speed for a short time.

[b]Q) My Multi-drop Deliveries won't complete. Help![/b]
 
[b]A)[/b] Some players may encounter a bug where multi-drop deliveries cannot be completed. If you encounter this, please restart your game. This will fix the issue.


[b]Q) What is the post-launch plan for Parcel Corps? [/b]

[b]A)[/b] There’s more to come, so keep your peepers peeled for a cyclist hurling a virtual newspaper in your direction in the coming weeks…

notes.title: Bicycle delivery sim Parcel Corps is delayed but at least it's funny about it
notes.notes:
We've been negligent in our duty as watchkeepers of extreme sports games. Parcel Corps is a light-hearted bicycle courier sim set in a colourful totalitarian regime where the police do not like things to be delivered in time, or at all. Perhaps that's why the game, which was due to arrive on Steam tomorrow, has been delayed until an unspecified date. That's okay, half the news stories we write seem to be about release setbacks. At least the developers announced the delay in a funny and thematically appropriate way.

notes.title: These Businesses Need Your Service!
notes.notes:
Hello future bicycle couriers! 

 

Whether you’re delivering for Das La Post or wheelie-ing with the Wallaby Wheelers, your objective is the same – to get as many businesses as possible around New Island to sign up for your services! 

 

Some of these business owners run small, humble services. Others more... eccentric ventures. Here are three business owners you will meet on your quest for delivery domination! 

 

[h3][b]Brawn’s Gym [/b][/h3]

 

[i][b]“Feel the burn, Bicycle Courier.” [/b][/i]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238128/6d47d90bcd4025f815621a33970b54d423d4e12a.png[/img]

Brawn, also known as “Bullchad”, is a muscular bodybuilder and gym instructor. He loves to lift, and attributes it to four of his five steps to get fit (alongside a certain enhancement substance).  

 

He needs someone to deliver a new supply of beef-flavoured energy supplements to his clients, as doing any kind of cardio would ruin his physique. Prove yourself by charging through the streets of the Parklands, following checkpoints like a bull to a red rag.  

 

You might just gain his approval and business if you do it quick enough. 

 

[h3][b]Ring’Os[/b][/h3]

 

[i][b]“We’re bringing good vibes, sugar glaze and rainbow sprinkles right into your esophagus.” [/b][/i]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238128/f56537cd65ca6c820e2201b1cefe1b9ab91b4678.png[/img]

Delivering for Ring’Os is sure to leave you doing doughnuts through New Island. With multiple happy customers and clientele, Ring’Os is booming – allowing for plenty of gigs for bicycle couriers. 

 

Feel the groove as you deliver these tasty treats in a timely manner. You may even get tasked with ‘mixing them up’ on route! 

 

[h3][b]Petal Pusher [/b][/h3]

 

[i][b]“We don’t sell Gas Flowers.” [/b][/i]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238128/8f0f285eddf97d9a03d71c9e55f9ac6a1f221011.png[/img]

Selling only the highest quality flowers, this solo entrepreneur has made her living by perfecting her patented compost recipe. The soil only has one side effect – the high potency of its fumes! 

 

When delivering to customers, one must not only handle the package with care to avoid spillages but needs to remain agile and always on the move. Failure to do so, and you may just wake up somewhere unfamiliar... 

 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2015960/Parcel_Corps/

notes.title: Become a Jet Set Radio Uber Eats rider in this upcoming Steam indie
notes.notes:
Parcel Corps is what happens when Uber Eats and Jet Set Radio get mashed together into their own, vibrant indie game. You're skidding, grinding, and doing tricks on a free-flowing bicycle across a colorful cityscape while trying to carve out the biggest piece of the pie for your bicycle courier business. You've just got the competition and the newly arrived crude oil CEO Rich Villainé to contend with, that's all. After the incredibly slick gameplay and style of Parcel Corps caught our eye, we decided to go hands-on and interview some of the team from Billy Goat Entertainment while at GDC in San Francisco.

Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: Ditch the 9-5 - A courier career awaits!
notes.notes:
Grab a helmet and slip into your spandex; it's time to join the gig economy. [i]Parcel Corps[/i], the extreme sports delivery-'em-up is preparing for delivery in 2024.

[i]Parcel Corps[/i] sees you mount your bike and sign a casual work agreement with one of three rival courier corporations. Embrace the life of a freelance bicycle courier as you deliver packages on the behest of an eclectic range of colourful customers. Witness as your earnings are sapped away by corporate overlords through exploitive contractual agreements you felt pressured into signing.

[previewyoutube=LfScWL-08HM;full][/previewyoutube]

Skid onto the sun kissed streets of New Island, where three bicycle courier corporations are vying to become the biggest, most profitable business in town! Pick a side then lock handlebars forming two-wheeled rivalries in pursuit of market share, influence, and a modest income.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238128/47b5b170cb6e626f7220e761bab7597b2df2dca8.gif[/img]

But this honest struggle to make ends meet is swiftly threatened by the arrival of Rich Villainé, CEO of crude oil exploration company Polar Petroleum PLC. Villainé’s political ambitions place him on a collision course with New Island’s bicycle messengers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238128/4b5e196a24457dd8082f02760d00f555fa46ccd7.gif[/img]

As the details of his maniacal plan become clear, it will be up to you, humble player, to *checks notes* save the world! All while delivering delicious food, valuable parcels, and sensitive documents in 32 minutes or less…

[i]Parcel Corps[/i] will grind on to PC and console in 2024 and is available to add to your Steam Wishlist this very moment: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2015960/Parcel_Corps/
